local out = { models = {} }
for name, path in pairs(player_manager.AllValidModels()) do
  local h = player_manager.TranslatePlayerHands(name)
  out.models[name] = { path = path, hands = h and h.model or "", hands_skin = h and h.skin or 0, hands_body = h and h.body or "" }
end
out.fallback = player_manager.TranslatePlayerModel("nonsense_name")
out.fallback_hands = player_manager.TranslatePlayerHands("nonsense_name")
return out
